notes: Prompt/config data for TypeSafe Jev (POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone, Authorization: Bearer $TYPESAFE_API_KEY, model jev-latest). NEVER use jevapi.org / tokenra.io (flagged as credential harvesting). Each object below is the 'questions' map for one call; the app fills 'state' at runtime. Choice criteria = {option: description}; score criteria = ordered levels (index 0..n-1 maps to 0..1); noul = probability.

plan.purpose: Instant intent parse of a typed/spoken request. Fired on submit; result drives local sample retrieval + groove templates within ~300 ms total.
plan.stateTemplate:
User request: "{prompt}"
Current session: bpm {bpm}; drum style {drumStyle}; sample {sampleName} ({sampleKey}); pads loaded: {padsSummary}.

scope.instructions: What does the user want the groovebox to do with this request?

criteria.full_beat: Make a whole beat or loop: drums AND a melodic sample/instrument (bass may be implied)
criteria.drums_only: Load or make drums only (kicks, snares, hats, a drum kit or drum pattern) — no melodic sample requested
criteria.sample_only: Find a melodic sample or loop only (piano, keys, guitar, strings, vocal, break) — no drums requested
criteria.bass_only: Only add or change a bassline
criteria.change_groove: Modify the existing drum pattern or feel (more laid back, busier, simpler, add fills, swing more) without loading new sounds
criteria.single_sound: Put one specific sound on one pad

drum_style.instructions: Which drum style or producer vibe does the request ask for? Use 'unspecified' if no drum style is implied. Artist, producer or song names count: map them to the closest style (e.g. NewJeans → jerseyclub, PinkPantheress → garage, Burna Boy → afrobeats, Metro Boomin → trap, Nujabes → jazzhop).

criteria.dilla: J Dilla / Slum Village / Donuts: drunk, unquantized, late snares, laid-back swing
criteria.jazzhop: Nujabes / Freddie Joachim / Uyama Hiroto jazz hop: soft swung drums, brushy hats, rim clicks
criteria.boombap: 90s boom bap: DJ Premier, Pete Rock, Wu-Tang, hard kick and snare, golden era
criteria.lofi: lo-fi hip hop / chill study beats: soft, muffled, dusty, relaxed
criteria.vintage: vintage 60s-70s soul and funk breaks, SP-1200 / MPC60 crunch, dusty vinyl drums
criteria.house: house / disco / deep house: four-on-the-floor kick, claps, open hats, 120-128 BPM (Kaytranada, Daft Punk)
criteria.trap: trap: 808s, rolling hi-hats, hard claps, 130-150 BPM
criteria.drill: UK/NY drill: sliding 808s, syncopated snares, triplet hats
criteria.rnb: R&B / neo soul slow jam: smooth, soft kick, finger snaps, 64-80 BPM
criteria.jerseyclub: Jersey club / Baltimore club: bouncy 5-kick 'bed squeak' pattern, chopped vocal shots, 130-145 BPM (NewJeans, LE SSERAFIM, Lil Uzi club songs)
criteria.garage: UK garage / 2-step: shuffled skippy hats, syncopated 2-step kicks, 128-138 BPM (PinkPantheress, Fred again.., Burial, Craig David, Disclosure)
criteria.afrobeats: Afrobeats / amapiano: log drums, clave rim patterns, shakers, bouncy 100-112 BPM (Burna Boy, Wizkid, Rema, Tems, Tyla)
criteria.kpop: K-pop / bright dance-pop / Y2K pop: punchy four-on-the-floor or pop grooves, 100-130 BPM (BLACKPINK, TWICE, aespa, Dua Lipa, The Weeknd)
criteria.unspecified: No drum style stated or implied

sample_style.instructions: Which style should the melodic sample/loop have? Use 'unspecified' if no melodic sample is requested or no style is implied. Artist, producer or song names count: map them to the closest style (e.g. NewJeans → jerseyclub, PinkPantheress → garage, Burna Boy → afrobeats, Metro Boomin → trap, Nujabes → jazzhop).

criteria.dilla: J Dilla soul-chop style: warm, sampled soul/jazz, slightly detuned
criteria.jazzhop: Nujabes / Freddie Joachim jazz: jazz piano, Rhodes, modal chords, melancholic and beautiful
criteria.boombap: 90s boom bap: dark jazz loops, dusty piano stabs, horn stabs
criteria.lofi: lo-fi chill: mellow keys, soft guitar, dreamy and nostalgic
criteria.vintage: vintage soul/funk record: old, dusty, crackly 60s-70s samples
criteria.house: house: chord stabs, organ, disco strings, uplifting
criteria.trap: trap: dark bells, plucks, piano melodies
criteria.drill: drill: dark strings, choirs, sliding melodies
criteria.rnb: R&B / neo soul: lush Rhodes, smooth guitar, jazzy chords
criteria.jerseyclub: Jersey club: bright chopped vocals, plucky synths, dreamy Y2K chords
criteria.garage: UK garage: soulful chopped vocals, warm organ / Rhodes chords, airy pads
criteria.afrobeats: Afrobeats: bright guitar licks, marimba / log drum melodies, warm keys
criteria.kpop: K-pop / dance-pop: bright synths, glossy pianos, catchy plucks
criteria.unspecified: No melodic style stated or implied

instrument.instructions: Which instrument should the melodic sample feature?

mood.instructions: What mood does the request suggest?

bars.instructions: How many bars long should the loop be?

tempo.instructions: What tempo range fits the request?

criteria.unspecified: no tempo implied beyond the style

laidback.instructions: How laid back / behind the beat / swung should the drums feel?
criteria: Very laid back, late snares, loose

vintage.instructions: How old / dusty / lo-fi should the sounds be?

energy.instructions: How energetic should the beat be?

brightness.instructions: How bright or dark should the sound be?

wants_bass.instructions: A bassline should be added under the beat (true unless the user asks for drums only, sample only, or explicitly says no bass).

criteria.false: no bassline wanted or not relevant

perform.purpose: Per-bar performer. Called ~1 bar ahead (at the start of bar N, decide bar N+1). Must return well within one bar (2.7 s at 89 BPM).
perform.stateTemplate: Style: {styleLabel}. BPM {bpm}. Bar {barInPhrase} of {phraseBars}. Energy {energy}. Last fill {barsSinceFill} bars ago ({lastFill}). Active parts: {activeParts}. Performer mode: {intensity}.

fill.instructions: Which drum fill (if any) should play in the NEXT bar? Fills belong mostly at the end of 4- or 8-bar phrases; don't repeat the same fill twice in a row.

criteria.snare_roll: snare roll building into the next phrase
criteria.hat_stutter: hi-hat stutter / ratchet on the last beat
criteria.kick_double: extra kicks at the end of the bar
criteria.dropout: drop the kick and snare for the second half of the bar
criteria.ghost_notes: add quiet ghost snares for extra swing
criteria.crash_next: crash cymbal on the downbeat of the following bar

energy.instructions: How much energy should the next bar have relative to the song's arc?

variation.instructions: The next bar should vary the hi-hat or kick pattern slightly instead of repeating exactly.

route.purpose: Single sound request -> which pad category, pitched?, decay. Used for 'single_sound' scope and for any sound ElevenLabs generates.

category.instructions: Which pad category best fits this sound description?

criteria.perc: percussion (conga, bongo, tambourine, woodblock, bottle, foley hit)
criteria.bass: bass guitar or synth bass note
criteria.fx: effect: riser, impact, sweep, vinyl stop, reverse
criteria.texture: background texture: vinyl crackle, rain, tape hiss, room tone
criteria.keys: piano / Rhodes / keys note or chord
criteria.synth: synth pluck, bell, lead or pad note

pitched.instructions: This sound has a clear musical pitch that should follow the track's key (as opposed to unpitched percussion or noise).

decay.instructions: How long is this sound's decay or tail?
